description: This file extends the CanvasWindowController class to manage and customize window and panel creation, positioning, and behavior within a macOS application. It includes methods for making windows, repositioning panels based on anchors or saved frames, handling screens, and responding to window lifecycle events.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures a new NSWindow or NSPanel based on the presentation type with specified content view.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Displays the panel anchored at a specified position, bringing it to front and activating the window.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Calculates and updates the panel’s position based on an anchor, saved frame, or default positioning.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Computes the default frame for placing a panel at the top-right corner of the given screen.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the panel’s frame, applying constraints to keep it within visible bounds.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Returns the screen that contains the anchor or the mouse cursor, or defaults to the main screen.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Returns the screen where the mouse cursor is currently located.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a given frame is at least partially visible on a specified screen.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Adjusts a frame to fit within the visible bounds of a screen, maintaining minimum sizes.
